summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Scrape History and Compare Across Dates features for Amazon India Listing Scraper. Backend APIs for runs/history management are fully functional. Frontend UI sections render correctly with proper data-testid attributes. CSV downloads use friendly filenames. Both Deep-Dive and Matrix comparison views work as expected.
